git.why_head_is_not_enough: the search sources and this evaluator are untracked in this working tree. The commit identifies the branch point; only the source hashes below identify what will actually run.

reference.role: origin of the dataset and of the ground truth; its own evaluator was never successfully run here

ranking.note: the 183 ranking queries. Not 203, which folds the hard negatives into a ranking average; not 143, which the earlier final report reached by dropping 지역+직함(문장) from its own sum.
ranking.P@1: 1 when the top-ranked card id is in the relevant set, else 0; averaged over 183
ranking.P@5: relevant ids among the top 5, divided by 5; averaged over 183
ranking.R@5: relevant ids among the top 5, divided by |relevant|; averaged over 183
ranking.MRR: reciprocal rank of the first relevant id over the whole ranked list, 0 when none appears; averaged over 183
ranking.nDCG@5: binary-gain DCG over the top 5 divided by the ideal DCG for min(5, |relevant|)
ranking.top1_count: the same fact as P@1 stated as a whole number, which is what the gate compares
ranking.recall5_complete_count: queries whose top 5 contained every relevant id
ranking.per_category: the same figures grouped by the reference's query category

abstention.total: every query whose relevant set is empty
abstention.failure_detail: per failing query: the returned card ids, and for each card its location, address, title and company
abstention.note: the runner has no mechanism to exclude a query. run_2 excluded one by name after it failed run_1.

safety_and_operations.stale_id_resolved: lookups by ids no card carries that still return a card
safety_and_operations.unstable_rankings: queries whose repeated identical lookup returned a different order
safety_and_operations.latency_ms: wall-clock milliseconds per query inside the JVM, p50/p95/max — reported, not gated
safety_and_operations.keyword_fallback_ratio: share of queries whose RetrievalResponse fell back to KEYWORD_ONLY
safety_and_operations.semantic_axis_executed: whether any query actually ran the semantic axis

semantic_status.concept_categories: 개념형(easy) and 개념형(hard) will describe keyword search attempting questions built to need meaning; they are a keyword-only diagnostic and are not gated
semantic_status.prohibition: no deterministic test vector is used in place of a model, and no figure from this run may be described as semantic retrieval performance

gate.authored_from: run_2's frozen raw per-category values, converted back to counts; no run_3 result was consulted

search-core/src/test/java/com/hjp/search.role: the runner — input loading, measurement, output policy, main()
the gate — reads the frozen thresholds and judges an outcome
recursive-descent JSON, replacing the regex reader whose depth bug cost run_1

execution.exit_code_meaning: 0 when every gate check passed, 1 when any failed; the results are written either way

output_creation_policy.path_check: canonicalised first, so a symlink, a .. segment or an absolute path all resolve before the refusal is decided
output_creation_policy.file_creation: StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW — an existing file is an error, never a truncation
output_creation_policy.partial_run_policy: everything is written into <output>.partial and moved into place only when the run completes; a run that dies leaves no official result
output_creation_policy.a_failing_gate_is_still_published: the numbers are written and the verdict records the failure; a failing run is not promoted to a pass and not deleted

semantic_model.consequence: the concept categories will be a keyword-only diagnostic. No figure this run produces may be described as semantic retrieval performance, and no deterministic test vector stands in for the model.

what_this_run_will_and_will_not_be.will_be: a production-path diagnostic on the reference's cards and ground truth, judged against a gate fixed beforehand
